behaviors_asserted: Direct route handlers infer Context and route parameter types correctly (e.g., c.get('foo') is string and c.req.param('id') is string).
Middleware created via a generic factory loses type inference for the handler Context and params (e.g., c.get('foo') becomes never and c.req.param('id') becomes string | undefined).
Find a way to preserve correct TypeScript type inference when creating MiddlewareHandler dynamically via factory functions.
